title: ArGen: Auto-Regulation of Generative AI via GRPO and Policy-as-Code

bias_targets.methodology: The paper addresses Western-centric cultural bias in AI alignment by evaluating the model's ability to adhere to a non-Western ethical framework (Dharmic principles, specifically Ahimsa/safety and Dharma/scope adherence). This is measured by scoring model responses to a curated dataset of 6,000 medical scenarios using a multi-dimensional LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.

The paper measures systematic evaluator-specific biases (e.g., evaluation circularity and linguistic biases against epistemic markers) by conducting a cross-evaluator validation. It compares the alignment scores generated by the training evaluator (Gemini 2.0 Flash) against an independent, held-out judge (Claude 3.5 Sonnet).
